summary: Tightened the prose, restored 'as of August 2026' status stamps, replaced vague claims with the paper's own quantification (72% reach decline), corrected the CrowdTangle date and publication count, removed the unsupported 'guided regulatory frameworks' assertion, and restored omitted JRC and EACEA details.

flags.claim: Following the shutdown of Meta's CrowdTangle in late 2024
flags.issue: The authoritative biography dates the CrowdTangle shutdown to 14 August 2024, not 'late 2024'. Corrected to the exact date.

flags.claim: His expertise has also guided European regulatory frameworks
flags.issue: No source says his work guided regulatory frameworks. The authoritative biography states only that he was a member of the JRC expert group, provided scientific oversight, monitored the data-access request process and authored summary reports. Reworded to those supported facts.

flags.claim: demonstrating a significant drop in Facebook visibility for Italian parliamentarians
flags.issue: His own paper quantifies the effect (72% peak-to-trough decline in re-elected MPs' per-post reach, partial recovery to ~65% of baseline). The vague intensifier 'significant' replaces the paper's precision; the quantification was restored.

flags.claim: over one hundred and sixty papers with thousands of citations
flags.issue: The publications data states exactly 160 publications and 2,395 citations; 'over one hundred and sixty' overstates the count. Corrected to 160 publications and roughly 2,400 citations.

flags.claim: He is an active member of the International Communication Association
flags.issue: Memberships are stamped 'as of August 2026' in the authoritative biography, which does not describe him as 'active'. Revised to a dated statement without the unsupported qualifier.

flags.claim: and has evaluated project proposals for the European Education and Culture Executive Agency
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states he was appointed evaluator and rapporteur and that, as of August 2026, the appointment ran to September 2026; the biography's past-tense phrasing dropped both the rapporteur role and the dated status. Restored (without naming any call or programme, per the confidentiality rule).

flags.claim: he served on a Joint Research Centre expert group assessing systemic risks on large online platforms
flags.issue: The authoritative biography specifies concrete duties in that role — scientific oversight of the group's research projects, monitoring the platform data-access request process, and authoring its summary reports delivered in 2026 — which the biography omitted. Restored.

flags.claim: Fabio Giglietto is a Full Professor of Internet Studies
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps this status 'as of August 2026'; the biography stated it as a timeless present. The stamp was restored here and for MINE's active status and the memberships.

flags.claim: introduced the coordinated link sharing behavior detection method to identify coordinated activity
flags.issue: Redundant phrasing ('coordinated... to identify coordinated activity'); tightened in the revision.
